systems.name: Suits
systems.summary: The ten suits provide Tau's most familiar card identity: color, family, and classic deck feel.

systems.name: Ranks
systems.summary: Ranks provide the standard 1-15 ordering, rank glyphs, themes, and the rank rail.

systems.name: Sequence Numbers
systems.summary: Sequence numbers provide the canonical 001-150 order used for publishing, references, and complete-deck organization.

systems.name: Spheres
systems.summary: Spheres are six 25-card mega-suits: Order, Air, Water, Fire, Earth, and Chaos.

systems.name: Modes
systems.summary: Modes are 25 recurring qualities that pair with spheres as a second suit/rank-like axis.

systems.name: Sphere Zodiac
systems.summary: The sphere zodiac is a sparse overlay tied to elemental sphere assignments and higher-rank planets.

systems.name: First Letters
systems.summary: First letters make the word layer usable for alphabetic filtering and word-building games.

systems.name: Letter Scores
systems.summary: Letter scores are a compact 1-6 value attached to the word layer.

systems.name: Directions
systems.summary: Directions create a near-four-way partition for movement, orientation, and spatial play.

systems.name: Border Scores
systems.summary: Border scores sum the edge values into a 0-16 scale.

systems.name: Border Arrangements
systems.summary: Border arrangements describe which card edges carry border marks.

systems.name: Border Zodiac
systems.summary: Border zodiac balances the card face visually while mapping border shapes into a second zodiac overlay.

systems.name: Words
systems.summary: Words are the 150-card vocabulary layer for play, prompts, narrative, and future card-specific flavor.

systems.name: Link Words
systems.summary: Link words turn the deck vocabulary into a directed graph of related terms.

systems.name: In-Link Counts
systems.summary: In-link count measures how many other cards point at a card through the word-link graph.

systems.name: Icon Groups
systems.summary: Icon groups split the 75 icon pairs into three balanced visual subsets.

systems.name: Partitions
systems.summary: Partitions are the 1-5 filled-symbol values on the lower rail.

systems.name: Icons
systems.summary: Icons are 75 paired scene glyphs: two cards share each icon, while avoiding shared rank and suit color.
